messages:
thomas (eng-manager): quick q — we approved a promo for Lila (ENG, UK) yesterday. People Ops set the effective date to 2025-04-15 (moved earlier from 2025-05-01). Payroll cutoff for april was on 2025-04-10. will she get retro pay on the next scheduled run or do we need an off-cycle? also, does this change affect her options grant date/cliff? cc @jada :thinking_face:

jada (People Ops): short answer: probably an off-cycle for UK if the approval came after payroll cutoff. can you drop the comp-change PDF + the approval email thread here? i'll open the MPY (manual pay) request once i have docs. on equity: usually grant docs use the signed grant date, not the promo effective date, but i'll ping equity ops. :mag:

jo (Payroll): fiscal/ops note — UK payroll structure is different. cutoff for changes to be included in that month's payrun was 2025-04-10. if approval occurred after cutoff we cannot amend the already-locked run; MPY required. typical flow: submit MPY with emp id, gross retro calc, GL code, approver. timeline: MPY processed and paid in 1–2 pay cycles. snippet for MPY body: ```employee: Lila K (UK) emp_id: 19872 period_from: 2025-04-15 period_to: 2025-04-30 calc: ((new_salary - old_salary) * days_active_in_period / 365) currency: GBP approver: People Ops```

maria (People Ops): flag — UK tax/reporting will reflect as separate line and PAYE adjustments might appear. send the national insurance details too. also, if we need a true off-cycle (urgent), finance requires CFO signoff for manual ad-hoc payment.

thomas (eng-manager): thanks. is there an SLA i can give Lila for when she’ll see the money? she’s asking today. :grimacing:

jo (Payroll): SLA: after MPY submission + finance approval -> payment in next scheduled payrun (likely within 1 cycle) or next +1 if timing unlucky. so usually within 2 cycles. if we do an approved ad-hoc manual payment we can cut sooner but that path is exceptional.

jada (People Ops): action list: @thomas — upload Comp Change PDF + approval thread to the promo folder and reply here. i'll create MPY ticket and ping finance for approval. @sam-equity — can you confirm whether equity grant date needs re-issuing to reflect the new effective date, and legal impact re: ISO timelines?

sam-equity: we use the signed grant paperwork timestamp as the grant date by default. if you want the grant to show the earlier effective date we would need to re-issue grant docs, which affects ISO start/cliff timing and may require legal review. tagging @legal-team-bot for T&C check.

thomas (eng-manager): one more — Lila gets a recurring on-call allowance. does that prorate with the promotion or is it separate?

jo (Payroll): on-call is handled as a taxable allowance. if the allowance is salary-linked we can pro-rate the remainder of the month in the MPY. otherwise, it stays on the existing schedule and we adjust future runs. include allowance line in the MPY calc.

legal-team-bot: note from legal — reissuing grant docs to change grant date can trigger new offer terms; please route through legal@redwood-inference with the proposed wording. potential tax/ISO implications for UK must be reviewed.

jada (People Ops): i'll open MPY ticket now and paste the link here when created. please add Lila's emp id + NI number in the doc upload. i'll also update the payroll-cutoff doc with a short FAQ entry so managers know the expected behavior. :memo:

system: MPY ticket created: MPY-3287 — assigned to jo (Payroll). ETA: payment expected by next pay cycle pending approvals. :white_check_mark:
